questions.stem: A 30-year-old woman presented with several weeks of increasing tiredness and fatigue. She feels worse after walking up stairs and symptoms improves with rest. Her menstrual periods last 5 days and are regular. On Examination: Respiratory rate: 16 breaths/minute; BP: 110/70 mm Hg; Pulse: 88 beats/minute; Pallor +, General appearance: normal Cardiovascular: normal Chest: clear to auscultation. Thyroid function: normal Oximeter: 98% CBC: Haematocrit: 28%, Haemoglobin: 9 g/dL Mean corpuscular volume (MCV): 74 fL ,White blood cells (WBCs): 7000/μL Platelets: 378,000/μL. Which of these does not cause this patient’s type of anemia?
